name: Holder Cove Campground
note: Small primitive campground of gravel sites in one clearing between Tellico River Rd (FR 210) and the upper Tellico River, about 16 miles above the ranger station and 450 m downstream of Big Oak Cove; a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post at each. The Forest Service gives no rig length and camper reports say only small RVs, so pad size for a 23-ft rig is unconfirmed. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/holder-cove-campground (read 2026-11-25, 'Site Open', page updated 2025-03-20): its own FS page and its own row in the FS Tellico River region campground list, separate from Big Oak Cove (11 sites) - 'This campground offers 7 campsites with a picnic table, fire ring, and lantern post', 'Single Site: $10 per night', 'Open year-round', vault toilet; rec.gov facility 10158728 active (is_deactivated false), 'first-come, first-served basis only', Scan & Pay. The Dyrt lists it Drive-In ('Park next to your site'; 2022 review 'Plenty of room for a small rv or tent, level gravel sites'; 2018 'Tent, Small RV, or teardrop spots'). FS alerts (read 2026-11-25) carry no Tellico River Rd / FR 210 closure. No rig length stated anywhere -> kept as an unclear-pad-size entry with a caveat (AWH 2026-11-02). Public, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-25: Esri World_Imagery at 35.2683,-84.0850 (hw 110 m and z19, both rendered) shows the campground as one open gravel clearing ~80 m x 25-30 m running NW-SE, the Tellico River a narrow dark channel under closed canopy along its NE edge (~5-15 m from the gravel, a thin riparian tree fringe between) - well under 30 m wide, so creekside, not riverfront. 3DEP (epqs.nationalmap.gov): clearing 755.1-756.1 m, stream channel 752.5-753.7 m ~20-25 m away, ~2 m down over a gentle bank: an easy walk down. All 7 sites sit in that one clearing, so every pad is within ~30 m of the stream. Corroborated (not the basis) by dated camper reports: The Dyrt 2022-04-17 'All sites here are on the river'; Campendium 2026-03-27 'Campsites are right on the river'. No site numbers published. Same setting and method as Big Oak Cove 4417 (creekside, p3-610).

fees.note: $10 a site a night; at most 5 people and 2 vehicles a site. Pay on site (Recreation.gov Scan & Pay).

fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/holder-cove-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night'; 'Fee is $10 per site.'; 'Maximum of 5 people and 2 vehicles at each site.'), read 2026-11-25; Scan & Pay from rec.gov 10158728 overview, read 2026-11-25; Campendium 'Last Nightly Rate $10 Reported 5/26/26'
booking_source: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10158728 via the public facility API ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.'), read 2026-11-25
sites_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/holder-cove-campground ('This campground offers 7 campsites with a picnic table, fire ring, and lantern post.'), read 2026-11-25; Campendium review 2026-03-27 'I believe there are 7 total sites'
facilities_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/holder-cove-campground ('Restrooms: Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-11-25
season_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/holder-cove-campground ('Operational Hours: Open year-round.'; 'Site Open' banner), read 2026-11-25
flags: SEPARATE from 4417 Big Oak Cove: its own FS page (7 sites vs Big Oak Cove's 11), its own row in the FS Tellico River campground list, its own rec.gov facility (10158728 vs 10158643), and on imagery its own gravel clearing ~450 m NNE of Big Oak Cove's gravel spurs at 35.2643,-84.0868 (both read 2026-11-25).

Pin: FS page point 35.2682,-84.0849, rec.gov 35.2682,-84.0851 and Google Maps 35.26831,-84.08495 all sit on the imagery clearing - pinned there. OSM node 5857298385 (35.27079,-84.08660) and Campendium (35.270982,-84.086226) are ~330 m NNW under closed canopy on the river with nothing visible - treated as off.

Campflare shows 'Closed ... current availability data indicates it may be temporarily closed', citing past FR 210 flood damage; the FS page says 'Site Open' and the FS alerts list (2026-11-25) has no Tellico River Rd closure, only Citico Creek. Likely Campflare reading rec.gov's FCFS no-inventory as closed - kept open.

Hookups group omitted: primitive sites, no potable water, and a 2022 Dyrt review says 'No water or power', but no agency source states electric/water/sewer and the rec.gov catalog is one placeholder 'Standard' NONELECTRIC site (too small to read electric 0 from).
Site count: FS and a 2026 camper say 7; The Dyrt's sidebar says 4. Wrote 7 (FS).
Unclear pad size: no FS length; camper reports say 'small RV', 'Tent, Small RV, or teardrop' and the access is a 'narrow paved road' (no agency rig restriction) - kept with a caveat in the note.
Google Maps: 4.5 stars / 18 reviews (gm.py 2026-11-25); its website link is the dead old recarea/?recid=35144 form - the r08 page is given instead.
Phone is the Tellico Ranger Station (as Birch Branch 15768 / Davis Branch 4418; Campendium lists the same); rec.gov lists none.
No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Smokies 54 km) - irrelevant for a federal campground. RV Life rating not looked up (public campground).
